units.passage: Taking credit for any work that is not your own original work constitutes academic misconduct and is subject to disciplinary action under UWS Chapter 14
units.why: "Taking credit for any work that is not your own original work constitutes academic misconduct ... under UWS Chapter 14" ties misuse to misconduct, P36.

units.passage: Generative AI used to assist in assignment completion in part (e.g., generating ideas, brainstorming, summarizing information) or in whole (e.g., submitting direct text from a Generative AI source) will be considered Academic Misconduct as defined by UWS Chapter 14 .
units.why: Assisted use "in part (e.g., generating ideas, brainstorming, summarizing information) or in whole ... will be considered Academic Misconduct", classing misuse as misconduct, P36.
